issues.span: The Buyer shall pay each invoice within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date (Net 15).
The platform stores and processes personal data of the Buyer's employees, including names, contact details, compensation and performance records.
The Supplier does not commit to any specific uptime percentage, and no service credits are payable for unavailability.
Either party may give sixty (60) days' notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term.
issues.label_note: Initial Term ends 2028-03-31 (24 months from 1 Apr 2026); 60 days before.

decoys.span: The aggregate liability of each party under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid by the Buyer in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
decoys.reason: Acceptable: trailing-12-month fees cap is the preferred position.

decoys.span: The Supplier shall indemnify the Buyer against third-party intellectual-property claims, subject to the limitation of liability in Clause 6.
decoys.reason: Acceptable: IP indemnity sits inside the cap.
